purpose: Freeze the scientifically admissible measurement frequency and observable family before any fiscal-reaction model selection. The retained quarterly primary balance remains valid source evidence, but the reaction-function boundary is moved to annual frequency because the official Commission output gap is annual/model-based.

rationale: The Commission AMECO output gap AVGDGP is an annual estimate from the EU Commonly Agreed Methodology; no official quarterly counterpart is frozen.
Interpolating or forward-filling annual output gaps into quarterly observations would manufacture pseudo-information and understate measurement uncertainty.
A source-consistent annual AMECO family exists for primary balance, output gap and Maastricht/EDP debt.

primary_balance.concept: Net lending (+) or net borrowing (-) excluding interest: general government, ESA 2010
primary_balance.preferred_unit: Percentage of GDP at current prices (excessive deficit procedure)

output_gap.concept: Gap between actual and potential gross domestic product
output_gap.unit: Percentage of potential gross domestic product at constant prices

debt.concept: General government consolidated gross debt: Excessive deficit procedure, ESA 2010
debt.preferred_unit: Percentage of GDP at current prices (excessive deficit procedure)

debt_gap_decision.reason: No stable empirically observed Romanian debt target has been identified. The Treaty 60% debt reference value is a legal surveillance reference, not evidence that Romanian primary-balance policy reacts to a fixed debt gap around 60%. The post-2024 framework is based on country-specific medium-term/net-expenditure paths and sustainability safeguards.

regime_identification_boundary.reason: The first actual-only annual boundary ends in 2024, leaving only one completed year under the reformed framework and strong overlap between the 2020 EDP and the 2020-2023 general escape clause. Separate regime coefficients would therefore be weakly or non-identifiable in a single-country annual sample.

next_gate: Preregister one parsimonious annual structural-selection candidate family before any fit. Freeze whether the target is primary-balance level or change, lag/timing conventions for AVGDGP and UDGG, baseline model, selection/evaluation windows and identifiability gates. Regime coefficients remain prohibited in the first cycle.
